_status: VERIFIED. Server sends ONE error message then closes immediately. WS error payload also carries 'tokens': [] per the API reference page. Branch on error_type, not error_message. Full catalog: https://soniox.com/docs/api-reference/errors

documented_codes.403: permission or temp key session expired
documented_codes.413: max_duration_reached (300 min) -> open a new connection
documented_codes.503: service_unavailable -> start a new request immediately

no_close_frame: Status 1006 (dropped without close frame): reconnect right away; no error JSON.
